name: Two Ingredient Pancakes
author: scj on based.cooking

ingredients.item: 2 egg or 1/3 cup egg whites from a carton or 2-3 egg whites from whole eggs
Dash of vanilla, nutmeg, cinnamon, and/or cloves (optional)
Choice of berries or other addition like chocolate chips (optional)

steps: Mash bananas into the eggs. Batter can be a bit chunky
Stir in optional additives if desired
